subject: Web Development
title: Caching Strategies
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Caching Strategies.

hook.text: The fastest HTTP request is the one that never happens. Caching makes that possible.

buildup.text: Cache-Control headers tell the browser how long to reuse a downloaded resource.

discovery.text: Immutable assets with content hashes can be cached forever — the filename changes when content does.

twist.text: Bad caching causes stale content bugs that are nearly impossible to debug from the server side.

climax.text: A solid caching strategy can eliminate 80% of requests on repeat visits.

punchline.text: Cache well and most requests disappear.

quiz.question: What can caching eliminate on repeat visits?
